_sql: {ctes} SELECT count(*), sum(length(coalesce(json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.tool_name'), json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.name'), json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.tool.name'), json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.input.path'), json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.arguments.path'), json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.path'), '')))  FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL

{ctes} SELECT count(*), sum(length(json_transform(json_extract(raw_data, '$.tool_use_blocks'), '[{"name": "VARCHAR", "input": {"path": "VARCHAR", "file_path": "VARCHAR"}}]')::VARCHAR)) FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL

{ctes} SELECT count(*), sum(len(list_concat(coalesce(regexp_extract_all(json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.tool.input.patch'), '\*\*\* (?:Add|Update|Delete) File: ([^\n]+)', 1), []::VARCHAR[]), coalesce(regexp_extract_all(json_extract_string(raw_data, '$.input.command'), '\*\*\* (?:Add|Update|Delete) File: ([^\n]+)', 1), []::VARCHAR[])))) FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL
{ctes} SELECT count(*), sum(length({projection})) FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL

{ctes} SELECT count(*), sum(length({projection})) FROM (SELECT * FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp, coalesce(id, ''), coalesce(dedup_key, ''), hash(raw_data) LIMIT 1000)
